name: Boarding Pass
summary: Every slide is a portrait boarding pass: a band in the airline color with a flight route whose plane flies one step further with every swipe, a perforated tear line with notches, icons instead of field labels, and a barcode stub.

accent.use: the airline color: the band with the route and the boarding button as it is; the field icons, itinerary stops, speech icon and postmark on the paper (a light accent is printed darker there)
